pokemon.name: Wolvyn
pokemon.appearance: Shaggy brown fur, cream facial and chest markings, dark oversized paws, fluffy cream-tipped tail, mischievous expression.
pokemon.pokedex_entry: Wolvyn is small, but it never backs down from a challenge. It fearlessly takes on Pokémon much larger than itself, using its sharp instincts and quick movements to get the upper hand. Its playful and mischievous nature often gets it into trouble, but its determination always helps it push through.
pokemon.notes: Species design, typing, abilities, base stats, and mandatory evolution at level 17 approved. Wolvyn learns moves only before evolving; later moves belong to evolved species.

pokemon.name: Wolvigor
pokemon.notes: Approved Wolvigor profile. Normal artwork linked as 002-Wolvigor.png; corrected shiny artwork awaiting upload under confirmed filename. Level 35 and later family moves belong to Wolvage.
pokemon.pokedex_entry: Wolvigor fiercely defends its territory against intruders, regardless of their size. Its powerful claws and relentless determination make it a formidable opponent, and it rarely retreats once a battle begins.
pokemon.appearance: Brown fur with cream markings and dark brown fur and paws.

pokemon.name: Wolvage
pokemon.notes: Final stage, evolves from Wolvigor at level 35. No hidden abilities. No gender-based appearance differences.
pokemon.pokedex_entry: Wolvage is a relentless fighter that refuses to surrender, even against overwhelming odds. Its massive claws can tear through solid rock, and its powerful muscles allow it to overpower opponents much larger than itself. Once it sets its sights on a challenge, nothing can convince it to back down.

pokemon.name: Solcub

abilities.name: Flash Fire
abilities.description: Grants immunity to damaging Fire-type moves and boosts the power of the user's Fire-type attacks by 50% after activation.

abilities.name: Solar Power
abilities.description: In harsh sunlight, increases Special Attack by 50%, but removes ⅛ of maximum HP at the end of each turn.

pokemon.notes: Approved #004 Solcub profile. Preserve exact Pokédex entry and existing normal artwork. Level-up moves on this profile stop before its automatic evolution at Level 18. Evolution EXP is retained.
pokemon.appearance: Small charcoal-black sun bear cub with orange-red fiery highlights, flames around rounded ears, bright yellow crescent chest marking, ember-like claws and paw pads, and amber eyes.
pokemon.personality: Playful, energetic, curious, mischievous and slightly hotheaded; affectionate toward trusted trainers.
pokemon.pokedex_entry: Solcub is an energetic and curious Pokémon that constantly investigates its surroundings. Its playful nature often leads it into trouble, causing the flames on its ears to flare with excitement. The golden crescent marking on its chest absorbs and stores energy from sunlight, serving as the source of its fiery power. When fully charged, the marking glows brightly, strengthening its flames and allowing Solcub to maintain its body heat even during the coldest nights. Despite its mischievous behavior, Solcub forms strong bonds with those it trusts.

custom_moves.name: Ember Claw
custom_moves.description: The user slashes the target with a claw engulfed in flames. This may also leave the target with a burn.

pokemon.notes: Approved #005 Solbruin profile. Existing Pokédex entry and approved normal artwork preserved. Learns only Level 19–35 moves in this stage; no move at evolution Level 18. Retains previously learned Solcub moves (including Ember Claw). Automatically evolves at Level 36 with cumulative EXP retained.
pokemon.appearance: Adolescent quadrupedal sun bear with charcoal-black fur, a fiery orange-red ridge along its spine, pronounced flaming ears and shoulders, strong forelegs, broad shoulders, glowing crescent chest marking and long ember-lit claws.
pokemon.pokedex_entry: Solbruin is an intelligent and resourceful Pokémon that uses its powerful claws to break apart fallen logs and uncover hidden food. The golden crescent on its chest has grown larger, allowing it to absorb and store far more sunlight than Solcub. This energy fuels the intense flames along its back and shoulders, which burn brighter as its reserves increase. Despite its imposing appearance, Solbruin prefers investigating unfamiliar things over confronting them.

custom_moves.name: Ember Claw
custom_moves.description: The user slashes the target with a claw engulfed in flames. This may also leave the target with a burn.

abilities.name: Solar Power

pokemon.notes: Approved #006 Solursus profile. Existing Pokédex entry and original solo artwork preserved. As the final stage, learns new moves only at Levels 39, 44, 49 and 55. No new evolution move at Level 36. Retains moves previously learned as Solcub or Solbruin (including Ember Claw). Cumulative Medium Slow EXP persists after evolution.
pokemon.personality: Calm, patient, disciplined, and formidable when threatened
pokemon.pokedex_entry: Solursus possesses an enormous reserve of solar energy within the golden crescent on its chest. When fully charged, the marking radiates intense heat, fueling the roaring flames that surround its massive body. Despite its fearsome appearance, Solursus is remarkably patient and rarely wastes energy on unnecessary confrontations. When threatened, however, it releases its stored power in devastating bursts of fire capable of scorching the ground beneath its paws.

custom_moves.name: Ember Claw
custom_moves.description: The user slashes the target with a claw engulfed in flames. This may also leave the target with a burn.

pokemon.name: Ripplet
pokemon.appearance: Small, primarily quadrupedal giant-salamander Pokémon with smooth deep-teal skin, a lighter cream-blue underside, expressive golden eyes, short sturdy legs and a broad paddle-shaped tail with translucent blue fin edges.
pokemon.pokedex_entry: Ripplet spends much of its time hiding beneath smooth stones in shallow streams. Its broad, paddle-shaped tail allows it to glide quietly through the water, creating gentle ripples along the surface. Although usually cautious, Ripplet becomes surprisingly energetic when hunting small aquatic creatures. When startled, it darts toward shelter with a sudden burst of speed.

abilities.name: Torrent
abilities.description: Increases the power of Water-type moves by 50% when the Pokémon has one-third or less of its maximum HP remaining.

abilities.name: Water Absorb
abilities.description: Grants immunity to Water-type moves and restores 25% of maximum HP when successfully affected by one.

pokemon.ability_assignment: Ability A (Torrent) or Ability B (Water Absorb), each with 50% probability. The assigned ability is retained through evolution. No hidden ability.
pokemon.notes: Approved #007 Ripplet profile. Preserve exact Pokédex entry and approved normal artwork. Special-attacking 325 BST. Seven level-up moves through Level 16; Level 20 Mud Shot belongs to Ripplash. Automatic evolution at Level 20 retains accumulated EXP and learned moves. Shiny color palette: deep purple body, pale underside, turquoise fins and golden eyes; no gender-based appearance differences.

pokemon.name: Ripplash
pokemon.appearance: Adolescent, primarily quadrupedal giant-salamander Pokémon with a broader head, thicker body, stronger legs and shoulders, deep-teal skin, a lighter underside, golden eyes and a larger muscular paddle-shaped tail with translucent fin edges.
pokemon.pokedex_entry: Ripplash has grown increasingly confident as its body and tail become stronger. It patrols the deeper sections of rivers, using its broad tail to stir up sediment and flush hidden prey from the riverbed. Despite its powerful swimming bursts, Ripplash prefers waiting patiently beneath submerged rocks before ambushing its prey. When defending its territory, it slams its tail against the water, producing a thunderous splash that warns intruders to stay away.

abilities.name: Torrent
abilities.description: Increases the power of Water-type moves by 50% when the Pokémon has one-third or less of its maximum HP remaining.

abilities.name: Water Absorb
abilities.description: Grants immunity to applicable Water-type moves and restores 25% of maximum HP when affected by one.

pokemon.ability_assignment: One regular ability (Torrent or Water Absorb) is assigned with equal 50% probability and retained from Ripplet through Ripplash and Riptorrent. No hidden ability.
pokemon.notes: Approved #008 Ripplash. Original normal artwork and exact Pokédex entry preserved. Retains 435 BST (higher than Normal/Fire middle evolutions). Learns five new moves at Levels 20,24,28,32,36; Torrent Break at Level 40 belongs to Riptorrent. Inherits previously learned Ripplet moves. Evolves automatically at Level 40 with retained cumulative EXP. Both genders use the same normal and shiny artwork. Approved shiny palette: deep purple body, pale silver underside, bright turquoise tail fins, original golden eyes.

pokemon.name: Riptorrent
pokemon.appearance: Massive, primarily quadrupedal giant-salamander Pokémon with a broad powerful head, heavily muscled body and limbs, deep-teal skin, a lighter underside, golden eyes and an enormous fan-shaped paddle tail with flowing translucent fins.
pokemon.pokedex_entry: Riptorrent rules the deepest stretches of rivers, where its enormous body remains nearly motionless beneath the current. Its powerful tail can generate torrents strong enough to sweep away large obstacles and reshape sections of the riverbed. Despite its tremendous strength, Riptorrent is a patient ambush predator that rarely pursues prey over long distances. When its territory is threatened, it unleashes a violent surge of water before disappearing into the depths.

abilities.name: Torrent
abilities.description: Increases Water-type move power by 50% while HP is at one-third of maximum or lower.

abilities.name: Water Absorb
abilities.description: Grants immunity to applicable Water-type moves and restores 25% of maximum HP when successfully affected by one.

pokemon.ability_assignment: One of two mutually exclusive regular abilities, each with equal (50%) assignment probability; the ability assigned to Ripplet is retained through Ripplash and Riptorrent. No hidden abilities.
pokemon.notes: Approved #009 Riptorrent. Preserve exact Pokédex description and existing normal artwork. Final-stage moves are Torrent Break at Level 40, Dive Level 44, Whirlpool Level 49, and Hydro Cannon Level 55. Torrent Break is Riptorrent's exclusive approved Everwild signature move. Prior stage moves and cumulative EXP are retained when evolving at Level 40. Approved 550 BST intentionally exceeds the Normal/Fire final stages.

custom_moves.name: Torrent Break
custom_moves.effect: 30% chance to lower the target's Speed by one stage.
custom_moves.description: A powerful torrent strikes the target and may lower its Speed.

pokemon.name: Foliko
pokemon.appearance: Small cute leaf-tailed gecko with golden eyes, cream underside, green-and-brown leaf camouflage, leafy head frills, wide gripping toes and broad leaf-shaped tail.
pokemon.design_status: Design and solo artwork approved; image upload pending
pokemon.pokedex_entry: Foliko spends most of its day hiding among fallen leaves and low branches. Its leaf-shaped tail and mottled skin make it nearly impossible to distinguish from surrounding foliage. When startled, it freezes completely, relying on its camouflage to escape detection. Curious by nature, it often follows unfamiliar sounds before quickly retreating into hiding.
pokemon.notes: Grass starter family. Names, concept designs, sizes, evolution levels approved. Abilities and movesets deferred; additional details to be added later.

pokemon.name: Folisk
pokemon.appearance: Agile adolescent leaf-tailed gecko with longer limbs, more angular leafy crest, green-brown camouflage and a larger raised leaf-shaped tail.
pokemon.design_status: Evolution concept approved; solo artwork pending
pokemon.pokedex_entry: Folisk is an agile climber that spends much of its life high in the forest canopy. Its enlarged toe pads allow it to cling securely to branches, even while hanging upside down. It patiently waits among the leaves for unsuspecting prey, striking with remarkable speed before disappearing back into the foliage.
pokemon.notes: Grass starter family. Names, concept designs, sizes, evolution levels approved. Abilities and movesets deferred; additional details to be added later.

pokemon.name: Foliraptor
pokemon.appearance: Athletic mature canopy gecko with elaborate layered leafy frills, elongated limbs, golden eyes and a large camouflage leaf-shaped tail.
pokemon.design_status: Evolution concept approved; solo artwork pending
pokemon.pokedex_entry: Foliraptor is a master of camouflage, capable of remaining completely undetected among dense forest vegetation. Its elaborate leaf-like scales blend seamlessly into the canopy, allowing it to ambush prey without warning. Despite its intimidating appearance, Foliraptor rarely confronts larger Pokémon, preferring to use its exceptional agility to escape danger.
pokemon.notes: Grass starter family. Names, concept designs, sizes, evolution levels approved. Abilities and movesets deferred; additional details to be added later.

pokemon.pokedex_entry: Kivolt is a playful Pokémon that generates static electricity as it runs through tall grass. Its spotted fur releases tiny sparks whenever it becomes excited. Young Kivolt frequently chase one another, unknowingly developing the extraordinary speed they will possess as adults.

Specialized pads on its paws absorb the impact of high-speed movement while its fur stores electrical energy. When approaching its maximum speed, bright sparks race along its body.

Its powerful legs generate tremendous electrical energy with every stride, causing its markings to glow brilliantly. When pursuing prey, Kivarion can release a concentrated burst of electricity to accelerate beyond its normal limits.
